messages:
maria (Platform): FYI opened a small docs PR that fixes some broken links and adds an SDK snippet for python auth flow. requesting a quick review when someone has a sec
alex (Docs): thanks — pinged the reviewers in the PR description. CI preview failed though, looks like the frontmatter validator flagged missing 'api_version' on one page
kevin (Eng): can we make that frontmatter optional for non-API pages? it seems noisy for small fixes
alex (Docs): it's intentional for pages under /reference but this is a tutorial so shouldn't need it. maybe the validator is matching files incorrectly
ci-bot: checks/run: docs-preview failed — Error: frontmatter.validation (page: docs/tutorials/auth.md)
docs-bot: note: CODEOWNERS requires at least one owner review for files under /docs/sdk/**
maria (Platform): ah, that explains the hold — this is just a tiny snippet change in /docs/guides/python-auth.md, not SDK reference
kevin (Eng): proposal: allow label-based override for CODEOWNERS on docs-only cosmetic changes. e.g., `docs:skip-owner` or `docs:quickfix` that a designated action can use to auto-merge after CI passes
alex (Docs): I like label approach but want guardrails. maybe auto-merge only if: 1) preview passes, 2) changes < 15 lines, 3) only markdown files touched
maria (Platform): agreed. we could also have a quick GH action that checks diffs and sets a `docs:ready` label automatically for tiny edits
kevin (Eng): I sketched an action snippet — can someone sanity-check?
kevin (Eng): ```yaml
name: docs-quick-label
on: pull_request
jobs:
  check-small-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: count changed files
        run: |
          git fetch --depth=1 origin ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          files=$(git diff --name-only origin/${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }} ${{ github.sha }})
          md_count=$(echo "$files" | grep -E '\\.(md|mdx)$' | wc -l)
          echo "md_count=$md_count"
          if [ $md_count -gt 5 ]; then exit 0; fi
      - name: add label
        uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@v1
        with:
          labels: docs:ready
```
alex (Docs): looks reasonable, but we need to ensure the action doesn't run for reference/API changes. maybe check path prefix and fail if `/docs/reference` touched
ci-bot: suggestion: add a step to grep for '/docs/reference' in $files and exit 1 if found
maria (Platform): ops question — who should be allowed to apply `docs:override` label manually? I don't want arbitrary merges by external contribs
kevin (Eng): make label-protected: only members of `docs-team` and `release-managers` can add it. GH branch protection can enforce require-reviews=false when label present (via another action)
alex (Docs): action needs a policy doc. I'll draft a tiny README in repo root: how the quick-label flow works, allowed people, and CI checks required
maria (Platform): awesome. for this specific PR, can someone manually add the label so the preview can rerun and we can merge during the next docs merge window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin (Eng): added `docs:ready` to PR #1427 — CI retriggered
ci-bot: checks/run: docs-preview queued...
alex (Docs): once preview is green I'll do an owner ping and merge during today's docs merge window (15:00 PST) :+1:
maria (Platform): thanks all. filing a follow-up issue for the action and policy so we can iterate. :memo:
